catalog.meta: Coverage: browser, control-api, messaging-execution. If it fails: frontend intent could bypass centralized validation, authorization, reason codes and audit ownership
catalog.summary: FastAPI remains the frontend-facing control API.
catalog.title: Control CTRL-API-CONTROL

catalog.meta: Coverage: browser, messaging-execution. If it fails: browser could bypass the control API and attempt unauthorized messaging/command injection
catalog.summary: Frontend does not connect directly to NATS.
catalog.title: Control CTRL-BROWSER-NATS

catalog.meta: Coverage: browser. If it fails: browser-originated input could reach host shell execution and mutate the server host
catalog.summary: Frontend does not execute shell commands.
catalog.title: Control CTRL-BROWSER-SHELL

catalog.meta: Coverage: control-api, durable-state. If it fails: enterprise membership could be elevated or the final active Owner could be removed without server-authoritative governance protection
catalog.summary: Enterprise authorization resolves active memberships server-side, restricts governance changes to authorized roles, invalidates affected authorization/session state, audits changes, and refuses removal or demotion of the final active Owner.
catalog.title: Control CTRL-ENTERPRISE-ROLE-FINAL-OWNER

catalog.meta: Coverage: durable-state, external-release, server-host. If it fails: secret-bearing or private-path evidence could enter canonical documentation or mislead security posture
catalog.summary: Runtime/scanner evidence is sanitized before canonical documentation ingestion.
catalog.title: Control CTRL-EVIDENCE-SANITIZE

catalog.meta: Coverage: messaging-execution, managed-device, server-host. If it fails: commands or recovery could execute outside worker/agent/supervisor ownership and lose delivery/recovery guarantees
catalog.summary: Workers, agents and supervisors own execution and recovery.
catalog.title: Control CTRL-EXECUTION-OWNERS

catalog.meta: Coverage: external-release, durable-state, server-host. If it fails: transient/unreviewed capture could be mistaken for canonical release/runtime evidence
catalog.summary: Runtime and scanner evidence promotion is explicit; MkDocs does not capture or promote.
catalog.title: Control CTRL-EXPLICIT-PROMOTION

catalog.meta: Coverage: browser, control-api, durable-state. If it fails: ambient browser session authority could be reused without a separate write-intent proof or reusable session material could be exposed
catalog.summary: Human browser writes require an authenticated local-owner session plus a separate same-site CSRF proof; session credentials remain HttpOnly and hash-only at rest.
catalog.title: Control CTRL-HUMAN-SESSION-CSRF

catalog.meta: Coverage: browser, control-api, durable-state. If it fails: a requester could bypass independent review, substitute action/target/revision context, or replay an already-consumed continuation
catalog.summary: Approval must come from a different currently eligible Owner/Admin with purpose-bound passkey step-up and exact action/target/revision binding; approval does not execute the action, and the initiator retry atomically consumes one continuation with replay refusal.
catalog.title: Control CTRL-INDEPENDENT-APPROVAL-CONTINUATION

catalog.meta: Coverage: control-api, messaging-execution. If it fails: a protected mutation could proceed without a valid authorization decision or while policy state is unavailable or ambiguous
catalog.summary: FastAPI preserves hard domain invariants, then requires a valid loopback OPA allow decision for registered protected actions before NATS/worker execution; unavailable, timed-out, malformed, or unregistered decisions fail closed.
catalog.title: Control CTRL-OPA-FAIL-CLOSED

catalog.meta: Coverage: control-api, durable-state, server-host. If it fails: the running policy could diverge from the intended active/known-good revision or remain ambiguous after activation/rollback uncertainty
catalog.summary: Typed policy candidates produce deterministic immutable revisions and manifests; activation proves loopback OPA observed revision/readiness before durable convergence, with known-good rollback/quarantine and explicit recovery proof when state is uncertain.
catalog.title: Control CTRL-POLICY-REVISION-LIFECYCLE

catalog.meta: Coverage: external-release, application-container. If it fails: unqualified dependencies or release artifacts could enter runtime without normalized SBOM/scanner evidence
catalog.summary: Pinned WSL2/CI tooling produces sanitized normalized SBOM/security evidence before docs consumption.
catalog.title: Control CTRL-SUPPLY-CHAIN

catalog.meta: Coverage: browser, control-api, durable-state. If it fails: a temporary catalog-install exception could be widened, reused after expiry/revoke, or applied outside its exact human/app/device/revision scope
catalog.summary: Temporary exceptions are restricted to catalog.install and exact app/device/human/policy revision, reject wildcard/global scope, expire within at most 60 minutes and can be revoked; matching enforces active unexpired exact scope.
catalog.title: Control CTRL-TEMPORARY-EXCEPTION-SCOPE

catalog.meta: Coverage: browser, control-api, durable-state. If it fails: a human session could gain privileged assurance without the intended short-lived, origin/RP-bound WebAuthn ceremony
catalog.summary: WebAuthn ceremonies bind short-lived server-owned challenges to purpose, origin and RP ID; passkey assertions update signer counters and purpose-bound step-up expires independently of the browser session.
catalog.title: Control CTRL-WEBAUTHN-ASSURANCE
